digest.component_or_area: metrics analyzer toolchain and dev bootstrap
propositions: The metrics analyzer toolchain (lizard, scc, jscpd) must be explicitly named in Makefile bootstrap paths to harden intent and prevent silent regression if the CI-motivated self-reference is later trimmed
Makefile install and install-unlocked targets must declare the metrics extra alongside dev to make structural metrics available in provisioned venvs
The two non-Python analyzers (scc via brew, jscpd via npm) require documented manual installation steps since they cannot arrive from Python extras
Local dev environment documentation must clarify that scc and jscpd are optional and their absence degrades gracefully to Unavailable rather than hard failure
A venv provisioned by the edited bootstrap targets must successfully import lizard 1.23.0 and run rebar metrics without error when non-Python analyzers are absent
Existing uv.lock already pins lizard transitively via the metrics extra; the Makefile changes are behavior-preserving today but prevent future regress
